title: fix(plugin-chatbot): bold next to CJK full-width punctuation renders bold
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UpnecJ99GYb6bUBiAmsEXW)_

Fixes #33723

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:聊天回答和推理面板里,中文字紧贴 `**`、另一侧是全角标点(《》「」,。!?、)时,粗体不再显示成字面星号;做法是给 streamdown 的 `cjk` 插槽接上 `remark-cjk-friendly`(新增一个 MIT 依赖,只取解析半边)。
- 为什么改:CommonMark 把全角标点当标点,中文句子里 `**` 两侧没有空格,定界符判不成开/闭;卡上原例「**《书名》，借书人**」单独渲染本来就是粗体,真正坏的是 `借书人是**《书名》**的作者` 这类「中文字 + ** + 全角标点」。
- 风险与回滚:只影响聊天 markdown 的强调解析;ASCII 粗体、行内代码、反斜杠转义保持 CommonMark 原义(有钉子);新依赖让聊天 bundle 增加约 5.6 KB gzip;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chatMarkdownPlugins.ts`(插件配置与理由)、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/message.tsx`(调用方自带 `plugins` 时仍保留 CJK 规则的合并)、`pnpm-lock.yaml`(只增不改)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatAnswerLayout-13032.test.tsx`,预期 29 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` adds the dependency `remark-cjk-friendly` `^2.3.4` and imports its `parseOnly` entry.
- A new module, `src/chatMarkdownPlugins.ts`, exports `CHAT_MARKDOWN_PLUGINS`: a streamdown `PluginConfig` whose `cjk` slot carries the plugin in `remarkPluginsBefore`, so it runs before remark-gfm and owns the emphasis tokenizer.
- Both chat markdown call sites render with that one constant, so they cannot drift:
  - `MessageResponse` (`src/elements/message.tsx`) passes `plugins={{ ...CHAT_MARKDOWN_PLUGINS, ...plugins }}`. A caller that passes its own `plugins` keeps the CJK rule unless it sets `cjk` itself.
  - `ReasoningContent` (`src/elements/reasoning.tsx`) passes `plugins={CHAT_MARKDOWN_PLUGINS}`.
- The module lives in `src/`, not `src/elements/`. `src/elements/` is the vendored directory that `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` skips, and the package test "the vendored directory stays vendored" refuses a file there with no vendor banner.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` only gains lines for the new package and its transitive deps. No existing resolution moves.

## Why

Card premise, corrected. The card's example on its own already renders bold on `origin/main` (`fb79d47c`, streamdown 2.5.0, read with `react-dom/server`): in `「**《书名》，借书人**」` the opener follows `「`, which is punctuation, so the run is left-flanking. The defect is a CJK **letter** beside the delimiter, with full-width punctuation on the other side:

- `借书人是**《书名》**的作者`: the opener follows a letter and precedes `《`, so it is not left-flanking.
- `他说**你好，**我们走`: the closer follows `，` and precedes a letter, so it is not right-flanking.

CommonMark counts full-width punctuation as punctuation, and a CJK sentence puts no space beside the run, so both stay literal asterisks. `remark-cjk-friendly` implements the markdown-cjk-friendly rule, which reads a CJK character beside the run the way it reads the whitespace an English sentence would have there.

### Dependency choice

The tree had nothing CJK-aware (remark-gfm 4.0.1, micromark 4.0.2), and streamdown's `plugins.cjk` slot was empty. The seat chose A from three options.

- **A, taken: `remark-cjk-friendly` `^2.3.4`, MIT.** It fixes emphasis at the tokenizer (a micromark extension). Its `parseOnly` entry pulls in `micromark-extension-cjk-friendly` 2.0.2 (MIT), `micromark-extension-cjk-friendly-util` 3.0.1 (MIT) and `get-east-asian-width` 1.6.0 (MIT). The other micromark utilities it needs were already in the tree. The lockfile also records the unused serializer half (`mdast-util-to-markdown-cjk-friendly` 1.0.2, `mdast-util-to-markdown` 2.2.3), because the package declares it. The chat never imports that half, so it is not bundled.
- **B, not taken: `@streamdown/cjk` 1.0.4, Apache-2.0.** It is A plus CJK strikethrough and autolink-boundary splitting, which is more surface than the card asks for.
- **C, not taken: a hand-written mdast post-step** that re-pairs literal `**` in text nodes. After parsing, an escaped `\*\*` and a failed delimiter are the same text, so this step would bold escaped asterisks. It is a workaround, not the root fix.

Bundle cost was measured with esbuild (minify, ESM, browser) on streamdown with and without the import, with react, mermaid and shiki external:

| entry | added, raw | added, gzip -9 |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `remark-cjk-friendly/parseOnly` (shipped) | 15,399 B | 5,580 B |
| `remark-cjk-friendly` (both halves, not shipped) | 40,893 B | 13,569 B |

In the Console, the `micromark…`/`remark-…` modules match the `vendor-markdown` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts`. That group is tagged `$initial`. The eager-closure ceiling (`ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`) is judged in CI by the Build & E2E UI job. It was not measured locally, because a full Console build was out of scope for this card.

## Tests

Pins go in the existing `MessageResponse` harness, `src/__tests__/chatAnswerLayout-13032.test.tsx`, as a new top-level `describe`: "bold next to CJK full-width punctuation (objectstack#33723)". No existing test was edited.

- **Reds that turn green (8):** an opener after a CJK letter, before `《` and before `「`; a closer after `，` `。` `！` `？` `、` `」`, each before a CJK letter.
- **Controls that were already bold (8):** the card's own example `「**《书名》，借书人**」`; bold ending before `，` `。` `！` `？` `、` `」`; bold starting after `「`.
- **CommonMark controls, unchanged (4):** ASCII emphasis (`**bold**`, `foo**bar**baz`); `a**"b"**c` stays literal, as CommonMark says; escaped `\*\*《书名》\*\*` stays literal; `**` inside an inline code span stays literal.
- **Wiring (2):** a caller's own `plugins` keeps the CJK rule; the reasoning panel renders with the same rule.

<details><summary>Ablation: remove the plugin from CHAT_MARKDOWN_PLUGINS</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/elements/markdown-plugins.ts --anchor 'PluginConfig = { cjk: CJK_EMPHASIS };' --replacement 'PluginConfig = { /* ablated */ };'`. This ran on commit `8bc8bf07`, before the module moved to `src/`. The ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source, so no build is needed between the mutation and the run.

```

```

The 10 reds are exactly the 8 failing cases plus the 2 wiring pins. All 19 controls stayed green.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` › "Bundle considerations" lists the package's markdown dependencies (`streamdown`, `shiki`, `mermaid`, `katex`) and does not name the new small parser extension. It was left as is because the section is about the heavy chunks.
- The eslint warnings on `message.tsx` and `reasoning.tsx` are all on lines this diff does not touch (0 errors).
- The real-browser chat-panel check that the delta lists as optional was not run.

## Verification

Local gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run at head `ac2b0a14`, each command's exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`:

```
Run reconciliation — 59 derived, 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).
```

- 58 of 59 exited 0. That includes `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (Test Files 171 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 5065 passed, 2 skipped), `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:override-consistency`, `check-osv-exemptions`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:changeset-fixed`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. It reported PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) because it reads the built `dist/` of every dual-build `@objectstack/*` package, and this container did not build them. The lockfile is the only path that derives this family, and the lockfile change adds packages to `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` alone. CI's Lint & Repo Gates job runs it.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- Not re-run after the derivation: the tree is 5 commits behind `origin/main`. None of those commits touches `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/**` or `pnpm-lock.yaml`. The derivation flagged it as STALE TREE.
- CI-owned families (Test UI shards, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI with the eager-closure budget) are judged on this PR's check-runs.
